text:
Hi Hasan,

Thanks for your time earlier. I've sent a meeting invite over for 2pm on
Tuesday 5th May. Ahead of the call, here's some more context on Encord and
how we help teams like Tractable and Standard AI on their data management,
curation and annotation.

Encord is an end-to-end data platform for multimodal AI teams. We bring
together three things that are usually stitched across separate tools:

   - Index: connect your raw data (images, video, sensor) directly from
   cloud storage, then search, filter and curate it using natural language and
   embeddings to find the slices that actually move model performance.
   - Annotate: a high-throughput labeling tool with model-assisted
   workflows, ontology versioning, and review pipelines built for
   production-scale CV teams.
   - Active: surface model failure modes, label errors and edge cases
   automatically, then route them back into curation and re-labeling.

A couple of things I thought might be most relevant for Motorway:

   - Tractable use Encord to manage labeling and curation across very large
   vehicle damage datasets: happy to discuss how they've structured ontologies
   and QA workflows on the call.

   assessment, damage detection), teams typically see the biggest lift from
   combining curation + active learning rather than just throwing more labels
